work_loops.name: review_current_diff
steps: niuma_shell or niuma_exec_command for focused tests
niuma_runtime_complete_turn for the processed event ids

work_loops.name: patch_safely
steps: niuma_repo(action='read') to get content and sha256
niuma_repo_edit(action='replace' or 'multi_replace', expected_sha256=sha256) for exact edits
niuma_apply_patch only for Codex *** Begin Patch file patches

work_loops.name: attachments
steps: niuma_file(action='read', rel_path=...) for UTF-8 text, original PNG/JPEG/WebP files and delivered blobs; images and original PDF/PPTX resources are emitted automatically, JS receives metadata
create output files under the active scope
niuma_file_send(path=..., to='user', mode='send') to send an attachment to the human user

work_loops.name: finish_turn
steps: send visible result with niuma_message_reply or niuma_message_send
call niuma_runtime_complete_turn with the turn/event ids from the delivered work

repo: Use niuma_repo(action='search', path=..., include_globs=...) to narrow candidate files. Search is case-insensitive by default; inspect incomplete, skipped_files and truncated_reason before treating an empty result as no match.
Use niuma_repo(action='read') for bounded text and whole-file sha256. Continue at next_start_line; if partial_last_line is true, reread that line with a larger max_bytes instead of skipping it.
Use list for immediate entries or list_dir with depth; page sorted results using next_offset with the same filters. If scan_truncated, narrow path instead. Traversal does not follow symlinks.
Use niuma_repo_edit(action='replace'|'multi_replace', expected_sha256=...) for exact small edits.
Use niuma_apply_patch only for Codex *** Begin Patch file patches.
After edits, inspect niuma_git(action='diff') and run focused validation.
file: 牛马Agent attachments are blob references, not browser uploads.

Use niuma_file(action='read', rel_path=...) for UTF-8 text or PNG/JPEG/WebP files/attachments. Images (up to 20 MiB) are automatically emitted to the model; JS receives metadata only. No image() helper or base64 text is needed. PDF and PPTX reads emit embedded resources containing original bytes for the client's native file reader. For image-only PDF pages, use the client's native page/image viewing; an empty text layer does not mean an empty document. Images and documents share four binary items and 20 MiB total per exec/wait result; yield before reading more.

The file bridge performs no local conversion, cropping, OCR or PDF/Office/audio/video parsing. Resource delivery alone is not proof of model access; use the client's native file reader and report unavailable content explicitly. Use info/blob_path for other file metadata/paths; those do not expose interpreted file content to the model. Do not claim unsupported media was read.

Use niuma_file_send(path=..., to='user', mode='send') to send an active-scope file. Set dst_group_id alone for another local Group (100 MiB total). Connect destinations require both dst_instance_id and dst_group_id.
shell: Use niuma_shell for short one-shot commands.

Use niuma_exec_command plus niuma_write_stdin for commands lasting up to timeout_s (default/max 600 seconds). Consume initial output, then poll incrementally until closed=true, including unread pages after exit.

cwd selects the starting directory; child programs retain host OS file/network permissions. It is not a sandbox. Keep cwd under the active scope and cap output with max_output_bytes. Check timed_out and cursor_expired; never infer success from empty output or replay uncertain input.
message: Visible 牛马Agent delivery must use niuma_message_send or niuma_message_reply.
Use niuma_message_reply with the current event_id for an existing thread.
Use niuma_tracked_send only for durable delegation that needs a task plus linked visible message.
Before replying, verify event_id; before any message, verify to. Avoid routine @all.
state: Use niuma_agent_state to keep focus, next_action, what_changed, active_task_id, and blockers fresh.
Update state at real transitions; do not let status replies replace actual work.
runtime_complete: Use niuma_runtime_complete_turn after processing Web Model turn event ids.
Completion is explicit control-plane hygiene; visible web chat text alone does not complete a turn.
If a browser-delivered turn has already been committed, missing completion should not block later delivery, but it still leaves stale status.
code_exec: Use niuma_code_exec for multi-step read/patch/test/diff/report loops.
Inside code mode, call nested tools as await tools.<toolName>({...}).
Use COMMON_WORK_LOOPS, tool_names(query), list_tools(query), and tool_help(query) when unsure.
